title: Worenine attenuates pulmonary fibrosis potentially through modulation of PBK/SRC-associated TGF-beta1/Smad and NF-kappaB signaling pathways.
authors: Li, Yafang; Chen, Na; Zhang, Yijie; Xiao, Juanjuan; Zhao, Shuang; Duan, Qiuhong; Zhu, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子药物worenine抗肺纤维化机制，涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the pharmacological mechanisms of worenine in pulmonary fibrosis (PF) through an integrative strategy combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation. METHODS: Potential targets of worenine and PF-related genes were obtained from public databases and integrated to construct interaction networks. Protein-protein interaction (PPI), GO, and KEGG enrichment analyses were performed to identify key targets and pathways. Molecular docking evaluated binding affinities between worenine and hub targets. The anti-fibrotic effects and mechanisms of worenine were validated in bleomycin-induced PF mice and in TGF-beta1-stimulated A549 and MRC-5 cells. RESULTS: A total of 116 overlapping targets were identified. Key targets included SRC, IL6, TNF, NFKB1, and PIK3CA. Enrichment analyses indicated that worenine regulates pathways related to inflammation and cellular stress, including TNF, IL-17, and HIF-1 signaling. Molecular docking showed strong binding affinities between worenine and core targets such as EZH2, PTGS2, PBK, SRC, NFKB1, and IL6. In vivo, worenine alleviated PF, reducing collagen deposition and improving histopathology. In vitro, worenine inhibited EMT and FMT, accompanied by suppression of PBK/SRC-associated TGF-beta1/Smad, ERK, and NF-kappaB signaling, as well as decreased secretion of IL-6, IL-8, and VEGFA. CONCLUSION: Worenine attenuates experimental pulmonary fibrosis, potentially through modulation of PBK/SRC-associated signaling and the TGF-beta1/Smad, ERK, and NF-kappaB pathways. These findings provide a rationale for further investigation of Worenine as a potential therapeutic candidate for PF.
abstract_zh: 目的：通过整合网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证的策略，阐明小檗碱（worenine）在肺纤维化（PF）中的药理机制。方法：从公共数据库获取小檗碱的潜在靶点和PF相关基因，并整合构建相互作用网络。进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）、GO和KEGG富集分析，以识别关键靶点和通路。分子对接评估小檗碱与核心靶点之间的结合亲和力。在博来霉素诱导的PF小鼠和TGF-β1刺激的A549和MRC-5细胞中验证小檗碱的抗纤维化效应和机制。结果：共鉴定出116个重叠靶点。关键靶点包括SRC、IL6、TNF、NFKB1和PIK3CA。富集分析表明，小檗碱调节与炎症和细胞应激相关的通路，包括TNF、IL-17和HIF-1信号通路。分子对接显示小檗碱与核心靶点如EZH2、PTGS2、PBK、SRC、NFKB1和IL6之间具有强结合亲和力。在体内，小檗碱缓解了PF，减少了胶原沉积并改善了组织病理学。在体外，小檗碱抑制了EMT和FMT，伴随PBK/SRC相关的TGF-β1/Smad、ERK和NF-κB信号通路抑制，以及IL-6、IL-8和VEGFA分泌减少。结论：小檗碱减轻实验性肺纤维化，可能通过调节PBK/SRC相关信号通路及TGF-β1/Smad、ERK和NF-κB通路实现。这些发现为小檗碱作为PF潜在治疗候选药物的进一步研究提供了依据。
